notes.title: Version 1.62
notes.notes:
By popular demand, we've reworked and changed the controls! You should feel right at home and familiar with the latest controls if you have played other RTS type of games before. If you have some requests, don't be shy to contact us!

We're continuing to make more levels and more items. We're in the making of doing "long play" levels. Those will be unlocked after the Lab.

Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New Version 1.42
notes.notes:
The new version is live and kicking! For this patch we added two more story missions as a weekend special bonus for you all. 

What can you expect coming out from the sewers? There will be something waiting for you, expect a whole new game mode. We really hope you'll like it!

A handful of achievements are also added for you to collect! Two of them are reserved for the end levels, just so you know.

Read up on the 1.4 patch here:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/434020/announcements/detail/660146771866343093

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Beta Version 1.4
notes.notes:
We released a new beta version including some new things:

- A new Hero, The Soldier
He uses an assault rifle that can be equipped with a grenade launcher and a flamethrower at the same time which is great for stopping Zombies.
His skills are:
* Roadblock, to block lanes for a while.
* Instant Recover, when he almost dies he recovers to full health.
* Field Medic, he can heal others but not himself.

- A new Turret, the Tesla turret. It shoots electrical charges which bounce from zombie to zombie. The last one in the chain will receive the most damage! 

- A couple of new story missions with new types of enemies

Improved controls: 
- Use the right mouse button to cancel actions
- Pan the camera by moving to the edge of the screen, like in RTS games. (Starcraft) *Still work in progress*

- Bug fixes, things reported on the discussion board and some issues we found ourselves

Please try it out and tell us what you think. :)

notes.title: New Release V.1.1
notes.notes:
We've just uploaded a new version, ready for the weekend. 

We've fixed tons of bugs reported by the great community. As well as balancing a few of the turrets.

- A new turret has been introduced, a Sniper Turret. Deals a great amount of damage!
- New levels with new villains, meet the raiders. Raiders with shields, suicide bombers, medics and more!

Good luck surviving the wasteland!
